parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; <short pause> but the night shineth as the day: <short pause> the darkness and the light are both alike to thee. <short pause> Psalm one hundred thirty-nine, verse twelve.

God, the darkness does not hide me from You. <short pause> Night and day are the same in Your sight. <short pause> As I lie down in the dark, I know You see me clearly and You are near. <short pause> I am not alone. <short pause> Amen.
